answer: A farm's weakness is predictability, so resistance should randomize scrutiny. Each close, a fixed fraction of identities is drawn into review by an epoch hash they cannot precompute; a drawn clone that fails a check loses a bonded stake, an anchor that ties it to the record. Because the draw is a whisper no clone can hear in advance, the whole fleet must behave honestly at every epoch or lose its bond in expectation. A terrace of clones multiplies that expected loss. Cost scales as p times bond per head, and is checkable from the atlas of the ledger.
